thread:
priya: trying to push v1.23.4-hotfix to prod but deploy-bot denied me — 'insufficient privileges: not in prod-deployers'. change window open until 21:00 UTC. anyone able to grant temporary deploy access for ~20m? release notes: https://internal/release/1.23.4 ticket INC-4821

deploy-bot: SYSTEM: deploy request blocked. user 'priya' missing role 'prod-deployer'. see https://internal/docs/deploy-perms for process.

ethan: we can do a handoff from @mike (deploy rota). @mike are you able to grant a short JIT?

mike: i can approve JIT from the admin console if security signs off. can do 30m TTL. priya — do you have rollback plan & canary ready?

sasha: security — MFA check: the prod-deployer role requires enrolled device + SSO claim. priya, are you enrolled? if not, we need an explicit exception and an audit entry. preferred: JIT with 30m TTL and audit id.

priya: i'm enrolled but SSO returns 403 when trying to assume role. reauthed twice. still blocked.

laura: ops note — avoid long-lived perms. manual escalation to deploy-admin works but please keep window minimal. service tokens for prod are disallowed.

mike: ok i'll open a JIT grant now. priya, confirm you'll run a 5% canary first and that rollback to 1.23.3 is scripted.

priya: confirmed. canary to 5% traffic, monitor error_rate + p95 latency. rollback command prepared.

oncall-ops: rollback command (kept in runbook):
```
./deploy rollback --env=prod --service=api-gateway --to-version=1.23.3 --reason="hotfix failed"
```
monitoring dashboards: https://dashboard/alerts/api-gateway

deploy-bot: ADMIN ACTION: Temporary role 'prod-deployer-JIT-2151234567' issued to priya for 30m. audit id: audit-7892. changes logged.

priya: starting canary now — patch applied to 5% slice. watching metrics.

priya: canary looks stable after 6m (errors flat, p95 +3ms). proceeding with gradual rollout.

mike: acknowledged. will re-lock perms once rollout completes. remember to rotate any keys touched.

sasha: security logged the exception and set an automated alert: trigger rollback if error_rate > 2.5x baseline for 3m. audit id attached.

priya: rollout complete. closing window. thanks everyone. @deploy-bot please revoke the JIT role.

deploy-bot: ADMIN ACTION: Role 'prod-deployer-JIT-2151234567' revoked. audit id: audit-7892. thread closed.
